design: FIXTURE-only live source arbiter; no target backend or persistent resume

reused_principles: kernel lock release or dead PID is not clean completion
release decisions use original live private result

allowed_automatic_reuse: original live owner only, after private bound completion, real normal child exit, clean EOF, decoded synthetic bytes, unchanged fence and valid deadline

sources.limited_support: flock ownership follows open file descriptions and may be released when all related descriptors close; this alone is not a source-return or hardware-recovery receipt

file and containing-directory synchronization have distinct requirements; synchronization documentation does not prove target RAM survives reset, authenticates a record, or provides a restart checkpoint

next_target_work: own Linux ARM64 live owner/worker state machine with enforced entry, bounded inherited private completion and UNKNOWN on liveness/completion loss; fake-kernel verification before any device action
